problem_context.problem_statement:
# StoreA migration contract

User authorized migrating both local singly and doubly linked list specifications and proofs. Definitions must align with crtosverify/master lib/dll.v, using current list specifications as the reference for operation semantics. Latest steering: reuse every applicable existing specification definition and proof; except for storeA keep existing versions as unchanged as possible. Do not alter executable C, node layout, API names, edge-case behavior, sentinel conventions or pointer ownership obligations unnecessarily. Do not add payload fields to C nodes.

Reference commit: d215f73b69916cc5c7c01af752bca4b6f96b3530. Exact reference files are in OUTPUT/xizi/xizi_double_link_common/reports/storeA_migration_reference/. They are design references only, not acceptance evidence. The DLL payload interface is addr -> A -> Assertion. IDNode.node_storeA is a pure addr -> Z -> Prop relation, lifted by store_idnode into Assertion. Resource ownership for next/prev belongs to the structural predicate, not the payload. Public generic records must preserve the pointer and abstract data relationship as DL_Node does.

Design the generic DLL recursion following reference dllseg, dllseg_shift, dllseg_shift_rev and store_dll, with necessary local layout adaptation isolated. Preserve existing safety/shape requirements where applicable and explicitly document any difference from reference rather than silently weaken existing specs. The new public resource-carrying definitions must actually be used by migrated C contracts, not be an unused wrapper or emp-only specialization. SLL must follow the same payload/structural ownership separation, while preserving current null-terminated and sentinel semantics and reusing generic proofs where possible.

Initial run uses the existing common library as its sole case_lib, through controller --case-lib-file. To keep downstream cases valid during sequential adoption, retain existing declarations unchanged and introduce the new generic definitions under clear new names; avoid duplicate copies of existing models/proofs. Later runs will migrate consumers. Current task is only the assigned initial function plus useful shared definitions and mathematical spec lemmas. Add Extern Coq declarations in the allowed target C, as headers are read-only in this round. Existing common-library imports can be reused. Do not update unrelated generated files, headers, other cases or other shared libraries.

Use the controller-provided actual driver and canonical -I/-slp settings. qcp-mcp tools are not exposed directly in the parent session, but local mcp/qcp-mcp Python Session wrapper and linux-binary/mcp are available; inspect/use the local wrapper for required interactive evidence, do not substitute direct symexec success. Only main-worktree coq_tooling.py check/debug for Coq feedback. Owner may fix recoverable problems inside its attempt. Root AGENTS.md overrides stale skill role/scratch descriptions: two fixed phases plus group workers; ownership is round worktree and allowed_write_paths.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Initialize the existing sentinel to an empty generic DLL for arbitrary A and storeA, with the same writable-link precondition and executable C as before. Bootstrap shared storeA definitions aligned with reference DLL while retaining existing declarations for unmigrated consumers.
spec_hint: Reference current xizi DLL definitions and master DLL definitions; actual new generic contract must quantify A/storeA, preserve node layout and reuse existing proofs where possible.
